name: Visual Lease
positioning: Lease accounting compliance first — for the tenant side, where a lease is a balance sheet liability.
description: Visual Lease is a lease administration and lease accounting platform aimed at occupiers and corporate real estate teams. It maintains a lease repository with critical dates and clauses, and produces the journal entries and disclosures required by ASC 842, IFRS 16 and GASB 87.
real_estate_use: Since IFRS 16 and ASC 842, a company that rents two hundred stores carries those leases on its balance sheet, and the auditor tests the calculation. Visual Lease exists because that computation cannot survive in a spreadsheet: every modification, renewal option and discount rate change has to be re-measured and evidenced.
features: Central lease repository with clauses and critical dates
ASC 842, IFRS 16 and GASB 87 calculation and disclosure reporting
Journal entry generation and ERP export
Rent payment scheduling and recovery review

use_cases.job: Produce audit-ready lease accounting entries for a multi-country lease portfolio
Never miss a renewal or break option across hundreds of sites
